description: This Java source file defines the main entry point, server state management, singleton pattern implementation, and command handling logic for the OFBiz startup process. It includes enumerations for server states and command types, as well as methods for starting, stopping, and querying the server status.

classes.name: Start
classes.description: Main class for initializing, controlling, and managing the OFBiz server lifecycle, employing singleton pattern and thread-safe state management.

classes.name: ServerState
classes.description: Enum representing possible server states: STARTING, RUNNING, STOPPING.

classes.name: CommandType
classes.description: Enum for dispatching commands such as HELP, STATUS, SHUTDOWN, START, with logic to determine command type based on user input.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing OFBiz commands like start, stop, status, or help based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Start class.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server and exits the JVM.
